Highly recommended, I'm very happy with the experience. The owners are super helpful and very professional. I've always taken my Cocker Spaniel to them and have always been satisfied with the work done!!! 🔝 …
I've been taking my cocker Cesare to Deborah for 8 years: they're professional, kind, very patient, and loving! All of them are amazing! I would never have left my Cesare in anyone else's hands.
All the staff are exceptional, very professional and know how to do their job, making our furry friends and us humans happy is a great satisfaction, congratulations😘😘😘 …
Wonderful experience, loving, patient, professional staff, the best for our furry friends ❤️❤️❤️

We took our 4-month-old cocker spaniel for his first grooming. They were all fantastic and so sweet, and they pampered and treated our little dog so lovingly that not only did he come out clean, smelling good, and wagging his tail happily, but he almost didn't want to leave, constantly looking for those last cuddles and kisses! They also have lots of beautiful snoods and other clothing and accessories worth checking out. It's nice to know there are still people who do their job with so much love and dedication!
Anyone who loves dogs and takes care of them can only expect a positive review from me. But I must add that this grooming salon truly exudes kindness, professionalism, and courtesy.

First time at this groomer today and I'm very satisfied! I brought my Akita, who is usually very timid, but the staff was truly fantastic: kind, patient, and attentive to every detail.
A special thanks to Mrs. Rosita, whose warm welcome immediately put us at ease. All her colleagues were also extremely helpful and attentive in treating my dog.
The result was excellent. I absolutely recommend this place and will definitely be back!

I highly recommend Mille Bolle Bau, I had a great experience!
They're super helpful, professional, and incredibly patient.
Thank you so much.

We brought our Newfoundland, and they were fantastic and very good. Our dog has never left a groomer so clean, smelling so good, and perfectly clipped. Congratulations, an unexpected discovery. We were worried because it's not easy to groom a Newfoundland.
Super satisfied.

Recommended by an acquaintance, I went for my first haircut and everything was fine. I called a second time, they gave me an appointment but I wasn't satisfied, but I understand it's summer and it's hot...that's normal. Third appointment, I missed it and arrived 15 minutes late, unfortunately due to an accident on a nearby road. They told me my dog ​​would be ready in 2 hours. I arrived early and heard a loud yell, "Stay still!" I looked out and saw my dog ​​still needing to be completely dried and brushed. As soon as she saw me, the lady handed her back to me and started telling me she wouldn't sit still, wouldn't let me dry her or brush her, that she was good but too nervous, that two people needed to work on her (a toy poodle) and that therefore the price was 50 euros instead of 45😱 and that if I wanted a discount next time, I had to pay cash!!!!! I'm going out with my dog, badly groomed—holes in his fur, one leg clipped too long, and the little face I asked for looked like a baboon! Bottom line: they'll never see me again, and I strongly advise against this grooming service!
It's worth it just for their kindness and thoughtfulness 💗 …
Thank you

If I could give 10 stars, I would. We went to Mille Bolle Bau with our long-haired cat because of her numerous knots. The girls were incredibly sweet and helpful, as well as extremely helpful, opening the shop an hour early especially for us, given our imminent departure and the cat's condition. It was our first time taking the cat to a groomer, and we'll definitely never change her! Thanks again, girls, and thanks to all the staff who lovingly pampered our little girl. See you soon!

I brought my long-haired dog, and they bathed him, leaving him soft and well-groomed.
Friendly staff.
Fair price.
Perfect experience. My French bulldog was reluctant to take baths. But they were super professional and he overcame his fear of water.
Kindness and professionalism... especially with dogs
